subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should PR #97932 land with `announceLastRun` persisted state and `status: "killed"` reconciliation for interrupted announce delivery once `check-lint` is resolved?
rationale: The code path appears correct, but automation should not decide the permanent stored-session semantics or accept a failed required check for a session/tool-boundary change.

options.title: Clean lint and accept current state transition
options.body: Rerun or resolve `check-lint`, then land if maintainers agree that aborted announce delivery should clear recovery markers and persist the parent session as non-running `killed`.

options.title: Choose a different terminal state
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired persisted state for a lost delivery-only announce run, update the reconciliation state and tests before merge.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery model
options.body: If inter-session delivery turns should share one generic recovery model, pause this PR and route that design before landing.

recommendation.title: Clean lint and accept current state transition
recommendation.body: Rerun or resolve `check-lint`, then land if maintainers agree that aborted announce delivery should clear recovery markers and persist the parent session as non-running `killed`.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent restart recovery lifecycle and Codex internal-turn work makes this the strongest history signal for the stored-session/tool-boundary decision.
